async def act(page):
    # Locate the 'Website url' textbox from the accessibility tree
    website_field = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Website url', exact=True)
    # Clear the field and fill with the desired URL
    await website_field.clear()
    await website_field.fill('byteblaze.github.io')
    
    # Find and click the save button; common names in GitLab
    save_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Save changes', exact=False)
    if await save_button.count() == 0:
        save_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Save profile', exact=False)
    if await save_button.count() == 0:
        save_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Save', exact=False)
    
    if await save_button.count() > 0:
        await save_button.scroll_into_view_if_needed()  # Ensure button is visible
        await save_button.click()
    else:
        raise Exception('Save button not found on the page.')
    
    # Wait for any network activity to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Additional wait for UI updates
